_readme: The menu of battle rules a story writer can pick from with a RULE: line.
Writers never edit this file - they pick a name from HOW-TO-WRITE-A-CHAPTER.md.
Adding one needs someone comfortable with the effects DSL in src/engine/types.ts.
text is printed word for word on the pre-battle brief: the player is never surprised.
side says whose leader the effects are attached to. balanceOverrides is optional and affects the whole match.
Any key starting with an underscore is a note and is ignored.

clip-farm.name: Clip Farm
clip-farm.text: At the end of their turn, if they played 2 or more cards, they draw a card.

the-room-remembers.name: The Room Remembers
the-room-remembers.text: At the start of your turn, if you control 3 or more characters, a random one of them gets +1/+1.

every-post-costs.name: Every Post Costs
every-post-costs.text: Whenever you play a card, deal 1 damage to your own leader.

sponsor-segment.name: Sponsor Segment
sponsor-segment.text: At the start of your turn, a random card in your hand costs (1) more.

suppressed-reach.name: Suppressed Reach
suppressed-reach.text: At the start of your turn a random card in your hand costs (1) more. At the end of your turn, draw a card. You are being throttled, not silenced.

autocomplete.name: Autocomplete
autocomplete.text: At the start of your turn a random card in your hand costs (1) less. At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to your leader. It plays beautifully and it is eating you.

running-on-fumes.name: Running on Fumes
running-on-fumes.text: Maximum Hype is 6 for both players this battle, and you draw an extra card at the start of your turn. Every idea, no energy to make any of them.

hall-repair.name: Hall Repair
hall-repair.text: At the start of your turn, restore 1 health to each damaged friendly character.

punchline-recursion.name: Punchline Recursion
punchline-recursion.text: Whenever you play an Action, add a copy of it to your hand that costs (1) more. The joke will not stop coming back, and it gets more expensive every time it does.

going-live.name: Going Live
going-live.text: They draw an extra card on their first turn. The room is loud and they came prepared.

blown-fuse.name: Blown Fuse
blown-fuse.text: The first card you play each turn blows a fuse: you have 1 less Hype next turn.

the-crowd-carries-you.name: The Crowd Carries You
the-crowd-carries-you.text: At the end of your turn, if you control 3 or more characters, restore 2 health to your leader.

she-wont-swing-first.name: She Won't Swing First
she-wont-swing-first.text: Their characters arrive Weakened — 1 less attack until their next turn. She is not here to fight you; she is here to be found.

the-court-reconvenes.name: The Court Reconvenes
the-court-reconvenes.text: The first time each turn one of your characters is defeated, draw a card.

nobody-really-dies-here.name: Nobody Really Dies Here
nobody-really-dies-here.text: The first character you lose each turn stands back up at 1 health, keeping everything done to it.

thirty-days-notice.name: Thirty Days' Notice
thirty-days-notice.text: At the start of your turn, deal 1 damage to your leader and draw a card. The clock is running and it is not going to stop.

best-mistake.name: Best Mistake
best-mistake.text: The first character you lose each turn leaves a 1/1 Glitchling behind. Nothing here is wasted, which is the problem.

it-came-back._note: Nobody Really Dies Here, aimed the other way: the thing across the table is the one that will not stay down.
it-came-back.name: It Came Back
it-came-back.text: The first character they lose each turn stands back up at 1 health, keeping everything done to it. It stopped being funny and it did not stop.

signal-dead-zone._note: Re-prices YOUR leader only. The other seat is the one who chose to be out here and is not reaching for anything.
signal-dead-zone.name: Signal Dead Zone
signal-dead-zone.text: Your Fixation costs 2 more Obsession this battle. No bars, no reception, and nothing to reach for.
